description: Attach script files to application or document events, such as open, save, export, place, selection changes and before or after printing (print events); list the attached listeners or remove one by id (Application/Document addEventListener)

eventType.description: For add: the event, such as beforePrint, afterPrint, afterOpen, beforeSave or afterSelectionChanged

handlerPath.description: For add: the script file run when the event happens (.jsx, .js or .jsxbin)

id.description: For remove: the listener id (from list)

target.description: Listen on the application (every document) or the active document

name: manage_event_listeners
title: Manage Event Listeners
